The first call becomes a protected oddity rather than a belief system.

The anomaly becomes an evidence problem with response effects already attached.
The bus is kept out of the area while ordinary road evidence is sought.
The warning appears operationally useful while becoming counterfactually unprovable.
Unit Four is positioned early enough to matter.
The precursor-driven deployment produces an undeniable benefit.
The same information chain now contains a life saved and a responder killed.
Personal grief is subordinated to work without disappearing.

A concrete rule replaces improvisation.

episodes.title: WHAT WE DID WITH THE WARNING

scenes.change: The climax is already distributed; Smith is not the only person acting.
Human agency produces states outside a single central script.
The unified graph breaks into bounded cells; central visibility degrades sharply.
They pay the real price of the chosen strategy: less central knowledge.
The human cost of reduced central knowledge becomes immediate and personal.
Knowledge and authority are separated under maximum pressure.
A lawful source-blind search begins.
The third route exists because professionals adapt, not because the story rewards disobedience.
ANDREJ KOŠIR — EXTRACTED / ALIVE / TRANSPORTING.

Consequences become institutional records rather than speeches.
The world is permanently changed by the completed case.
Smith’s change lands in ordinary behavior rather than a doctrine speech.
